title: Christmas Lights Run - Modified Friday Night Fun Run
seo_title: Christmas Lights Run at W.F. Cody's, Springfield MO
description: This is a Friday night fun run to look at Christmas lights, held in place of the usual woods outing during hunting season. The ride is friendly to all vehicles, and families are welcome. Bring a GMRS/FRS radio if you have one (not required; a couple of loaners are available). Meet at W.F. Cody's, 3138 E Sunshine St in Springfield, MO, on Friday, November 27, 2026 at 7:00 PM, with departure around 7:15-7:30.
address: 3138 E Sunshine St,Springfield,MO,United States, Springfield, MO
